basis: NVIDIA FY2027 Q2 quarter ended 2026-07-26; direct customer headquarters geography
warning: This is revenue by direct-customer headquarters, not chip units, shipment destination, final user, billing route or data-center location.

literal_no_direct_sales_to_Taiwan_Hong_K.upper_bound_logic: Assign all China_and_Hong_Kong revenue to Hong Kong and all Other revenue to Southeast Asia. This is a mathematical ceiling, not an estimate.
literal_no_direct_sales_to_Taiwan_Hong_K.realistic_data_limit: Hong Kong, Southeast Asia and Europe are not separately disclosed; no exact regional loss can be calculated from the filing.

policy_end_use_scenario.description: Controls target China-linked final use and offshore compute/transshipment, while legitimate Taiwan/SEA/EU/US final demand remains eligible.
policy_end_use_scenario.model_status: Subjective scenario from the existing research model; not an NVIDIA customer disclosure.

chip_unit_warning: NVIDIA does not disclose chip units by region. Product mix, ASP, complete servers, networking and memory make revenue shares an invalid unit-share calculation.
